text:
sam: Following up on the postmortemwe need a tight remediation plan for token validation + secrets rotation. I'll capture owners; please ack and confirm ETAs.

jin: ack. i'll own the signature/kid validation hardening.

olga: ack. i'll do rotation verification automation + the PR gate.

mike: ack. i'll take audit logging + alert rules.

sam: top-level tasks: 
- M1: validation hardening (sig + kid + exp + clock skew handling) - owner: jin - ETA: 12d
- M2: rotation-verification CI job (preflight + post-rotate smoke + rollback) - owner: olga - ETA: 14d
- M3: audit log enrichment + 45d retention + dashboard tile - owner: mike - ETA: 6d
- M4: alerting & runbook link (pager at 0.4%/15m) - owner: mike - ETA: 7d
- M5: weekly rotation health job for 8 weeks (automated) - owner: ops-bot - ETA: 3d to schedule

jin: for M1 I'll add an integration test that simulates stale kid resolution and clock drift. will post test snippet in PR. target PR date: 2024-08-04.

olga: M2 plan: preflight uses ops-cli to verify secret presence in all envs; post-merge runs rotate in canary region and validates token exchange within 20m. gate fails if any step errors. PR target: 2024-08-10.

mike: M3 logging proposal: sample=0.35 for 30d, include fields user_id, client_id, token_kid, validation_code. dashboard query and alert added. PR: 2024-08-01.

ops-bot: Created calendar "rotation-health-checks" weekly Weds 09:00 PT for 8 weeks; ticket ROT-912 created and assigned to olga.

sam: recurrence observation: last 7 months show 3 clusters around vendor cert windows. primary fix = preflight + gating + better visibility.

jin: will canary for 48h after merge, escalate if validation-failure-rate > 0.2% in canary.

olga: gating detail: block merges if rotation success_rate < 99.5% across envs in last 1h. i'll add metric check to job.

mike: alerting detail: page SRE at 0.5% failures sustained 15m; post to #token-ops. runbook linked in alert.

sam: owners please label PRs with "incident-1767778888-remediate" and add links to the remediation tracker. i'll run a quick check-in next Tues.

jin: ETA confirmed 2024-08-04.

olga: ETA confirmed 2024-08-10.

mike: ETA confirmed 2024-08-01.

sam: thanks all. closing thread after tracker updated. :thumbsup:
